label: Business Academy Aarhus: IB application and documents

rounds.label: IB and other international qualifications
rounds.note: Annual deadline stated without a year; apply by noon even if also assessed in quota 1. Later vacancies are conditional, not guaranteed.

milestones.label: BAAA: IB application and available documents
milestones.note: The programme states 15 March noon without an intake year; confirm the annual deadline for 2027.

milestones.label: BAAA: sign your application
milestones.note: Use MitID, or the generated signature-page process if you have no MitID. Send the signed page to the institution by the deadline; do not upload it as an ordinary attachment.

milestones.label: BAAA: quota 2 video and additional qualifications
milestones.note: Submit with the application or it is not included in assessment. Later nemStudie uploads do not extend the assessment deadline.

milestones.label: BAAA: final diploma after graduation
milestones.note: Upload on receipt under admissions instructions. General exam-completion rule is 5 July, but no dated IB-final exception or BAAA results-service code is published. Confirm the May 2027 IB process.

milestones.label: BAAA: main-round admission letters
milestones.note: Special-route applicants without a Danish residence permit may receive an earlier answer.

milestones.label: BAAA: accept your offered study place
milestones.note: Published in the live August 2027 calendar; follow your admission letter.

milestones.label: BAAA: vacant places for non-Danish qualifications

readerAccess.reason: Only if BAAA announces available places and you meet applicable entry and special-route conditions.

milestones.note: Check that Multimedia Design has vacancies and follow the announced application process; this is not a guaranteed later round.

submissionItems.label: Diploma and transcript, or latest transcript if graduating later
submissionItems.note: No separate predicted-grade deadline is published; use the latest transcript and admissions instructions.

submissionItems.label: BAAA verification form signed and stamped by your school
submissionItems.note: Document teaching hours in relevant subjects during the final three upper-secondary years.

submissionItems.label: PDF linking to your three-minute creative-project video
submissionItems.note: Quota 2 selection evidence: introduction on camera, up to four projects, roles and creative process.

submissionItems.label: Final diploma when received
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: Your application following BAAA admissions instructions

supplementarySteps: Read messages in nemStudie after applying.
Confirm how BAAA handles May 2027 IB results under its July exam-completion rule; do not substitute a guessed final-document deadline.
If citizenship or qualifying exam is non-EU, check special-route rules even if tuition-exempt.
